description: Put a drawing on a sheet (id, number or name) where there's clear room, at the largest usual scale that fits unless scale is given: kind plan (level), elevation or section (view south|north|east|west|section-ew|section-ns), view (a saved view's picture), schedule (view = openings|rooms|walls|slabs|stairs|columns|beams|ramps|lifts|parking|furniture) or note (text). x, y: its centre, mm from the sheet's top left.
name: place_drawing
title: Place a drawing on a sheet
